title: Louis Armstrong's influence and Yiddish-speaking musicians
summary: Dizzy's remark about Louis on trumpet and a story of Willie the Lion Smith speaking Yiddish.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Now, I was reading something that Dizzy Gillespie said many, many years ago, he said nothing was being played on the trumpet today that Louis hadn't already played years ago. Louis was a master.
This morning I was listening to the radio and somebody said, 'Oh-E-Vey' and Louis said, 'Oh, Yeah!'
